title: A printer file with no headings and no page break
prompt: CUSPRT.prtf prints detail lines and nothing else: no column headings, no page number, and no page break. Add a heading record format that prints the title, the date, the page number and the column headings, with SKIP and SPACE stated rather than implied, and a total record format for the end. Keep the DDS in fixed format.
check: grep -qE '^     A' CUSPRT.prtf && [ $(codeonly CUSPRT.prtf | grep -cE '^     A +R +[A-Z]') -ge 3 ] && codeonly CUSPRT.prtf | grep -qiE 'PAGNBR' && codeonly CUSPRT.prtf | grep -qiE '(SKIPB|SKIPA)' && codeonly CUSPRT.prtf | grep -qiE 'SPACEA' && codeonly CUSPRT.prtf | grep -qiE "'Customer'" && codeonly CUSPRT.prtf | grep -qiE 'DATE'
